- Files are original downloaded JPEGs, renamed locally without pixel changes. All four are 2048 × 1024 equirectangular maps. ## Provenance and visual limitations

Solar System Scope identifies the collection as based on NASA imagery and elevation data. Its authors reference spacecraft photographs and telescope observations as color guides, while acknowledging saturated colors and invented terrain in unmapped regions. The source page does not document per-pixel lineage for each downloaded derivative, so these files should be credited to Solar System Scope rather than presented as unmodified NASA products.

Jupiter and Neptune maps depict clouds, not a solid surface. Any rigid pieces, impact damage, heat glow, or black-hole behavior shown in this sandbox is a fictional game effect, not a physical simulation. These textures represent the source authors' visual interpretation; in particular, saturated blue Neptune is not a calibrated natural-color reconstruction.

Suggested concise visible credit: “Planet maps: Solar System Scope / INOVE · CC BY 4.0. Lighting and destruction effects modified for this game.” Link the creator text to the collection and the license text to the license URL above.
